title: The Rain Barrel Lid
youtube_title: The Rain Barrel Lid | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Finishing together matters more than finishing first.
summary: At a garden row with string and two watering cans, a rain barrel lid that was wide and not heavy, just awkward will go wrong if one person rushes. Yael and Idris split it into two slow jobs, while Miss Dalca only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
